question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. PREFUNCTORY
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Cursory**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"perfunctory"** means an action or gesture carried out with minimum effort or reflection, often done hastily or superficially. (उदासीन या बिना मन का कार्य)
 
 
• **Example: **He gave a perfunctory nod before leaving the room.
 
 
• **"Cursory"** is the synonym of perfunctory and refers to something done quickly and without thoroughness. (सरसरी तौर पर)
 
 
• **Example: **She gave the report a cursory glance before submitting it.
